newsitem.title: POLAND: NKT Cables ups stake in Kable to 50 pct.
newsitem.headline: NKT Cables ups stake in Kable to 50 pct.

text.p: NKT Cables has doubled its stake in Polish cable maker Kable SA to 50 percent in a public tender offer by buying all the shares held by the Investment Fund for Central and Eastern Europe, Kable said on Tuesday.

"At present NKT Cables is the owner of all series A common shares of the firm's second issue, giving it 50 percent of shares and 50 percent of shareholder votes in Slaska Fabryka Kabli SA," the Tuesday statement said.
The statement said NKT Cables now held 1,000,000 common shares and that the Danish-based investment fund held none.
Late last month NKT Cables called two public tender offers at 27.9 zlotys each for the 1.5 million outstanding shares, or 75 percent of Kable, it did not own.
Kable's current shareholders have until March 28 to subscribe to sell the shares.
The firm's shares closed on the Warsaw bourse at 39.1 zlotys on Tuesday.
